title: Please Stay On The Line (Part 2)
description: Todd added the whole studio to the cancellation queue during sign-off, and now Snazzie FM is broadcasting from inside the hold music. The phone won't hang up, the automated voice has started hosting the show, and Sal is somehow caller number forty one thousand and one. Ronnie tries to stay smooth from behind physics.

lines.speaker: phone
lines.text: Your call is important to us. <p:0.3> Welcome back to Snazzie FM. You are still on the line.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: [surprise-oh] Ronnie, the phone is doing the intro now. The PHONE is doing your intro.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Easy, Barry. For the folks just tuning in, we are broadcasting live from inside a cancellation hold queue. <p:0.3> Todd put us here. The studio phone will not hang up. <p:0.3> Otherwise, normal show.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: It is not a normal show. We are ON HOLD. We are the hold music now.

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: And we're making great time, boss! Whole studio in one queue. Real synergy.

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: Todd, I have been holding to cancel a SEVEN DAY trial. <p:0.3> The free week ended. I got charged. I got charged TWICE.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: [question-ah] Twice? You held so long it renewed?

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: It renewed for a YEAR I wasn't here for, Barry!

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: Now you understand, friend. <p:0.3> The trial was never free. <p:0.3> You're paying in the only thing they take here.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Which is?

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: A while.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now hold on. Mr. Chen, you've been deeper in this queue than anybody. <p:0.3> You ever actually reach a person?

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: Once. <p:0.3> I pressed zero for an agent. <p:0.4> The agent was me. Older. Still holding.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: [surprise-wa] That's not customer service, that's a HAUNTING.

lines.speaker: phone
lines.text: Your call is important to us. Press one to cancel. Press two to remain on hold forever. <p:0.3> Please note, both buttons are two.

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: Both buttons are TWO? Then where's the one? WHERE is the one!

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: I pressed one for you already, boss! <p:0.3> Three years ago. It's still ringing. Real promising tone, though.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, kill the phone. Pull the cord. Pull the whole jack out of the wall.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: I pulled it, Barry. <p:0.3> The cord's in my hand. <p:0.4> We're still connected.

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: The cord was never what held you, friend.

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: Okay. Okay. New plan. I'm hanging up MY phone. I drop the call, I'm out, I eat the year.

lines.speaker: phone
lines.text: Thank you for hanging up. <p:0.3> You have been moved to the front of a new line. <p:0.3> Welcome, caller number one.

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: Number one? <p:0.3> I'm FIRST? I'm first this time, that's, wait, that's good, right? Ronnie, tell me that's good!

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Huge news, boss! <p:0.3> Different queue, fresh start. You're caller number one of forty one thousand!

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: That's the SAME amount of people, Todd!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: [surprise-oh] We started a SECOND queue!

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: We're scaling, boss!

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: I was you. <p:0.3> Both of you.

lines.speaker: phone
lines.text: Please stay on the line. <p:0.3> An agent is hosting now.

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Still holding, boss!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Well, you heard it. The phone's got the desk now. <p:0.4> We'll be right back, after we hold. <p:0.3> Press two to stay tuned. <p:0.3> Press two to leave.

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Oh, and boss? <p:0.3> I gave the phone your job. <p:0.3> It said thanks. It put YOU in the queue.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: ...I'm in the queue. <p:0.4> Sal, Mr. Chen, looks like we're holding together. <p:0.3> Forty one thousand and three. <p:0.3> See you next week. <p:0.4> If it's still a week.
